subject: Student Dress Code Policy
overview: The Rules and Policy Subcommittee met to review and refine proposed revisions to the Medford Public Schools student dress code policy. The subcommittee agreed on text addressing physical education safety, recess attire, profanity, and undergarments, and voted to report the policy favorably to the full School Committee.

items.title: Student Dress Code Policy Draft Review
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed administrative recommendations on the draft dress code policy, revising sections on safety attire in physical education and recess, guidelines on profanity and disruption, and rules regarding undergarment visibility.

items.title: Report Out Student Dress Code Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to report out the draft dress code policy language favorably to the full School Committee.
